SELECT COALESCE(h.area_code, h.qxdm) AS district_code, MAX(COALESCE(h.area_name, h.qxmc, '未知区县')) AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT h.htbh) AS total_contracts, COALESCE(SUM(h.htmj_m), 0) AS total_contract_area_mu, COALESCE(SUM(h.cbfyjzehb), 0) AS total_rent_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.hcdkbh) AS total_parcels, COALESCE(SUM(d.htmj_m), 0) AS total_parcel_area_mu FROM jgpt_htxx h LEFT JOIN jgpt_dkhc d ON h.htbh = d.htbh AND (d.del_flag = '0' OR d.del_flag IS NULL)
(h.del_flag = '0' OR h.del_flag IS NULL)
AND (h.area_code = #{areaCode} OR h.qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
GROUP BY COALESCE(h.area_code, h.qxdm) ORDER BY total_contract_area_mu DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(zzlx), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(zzzw), ''), '未申报作物') AS crop_name, COUNT(1) AS parcel_count, COALESCE(SUM(htmj_m), 0) AS total_area_mu, CASE WHEN zzlx LIKE '%小麦%' OR zzlx LIKE '%玉米%' OR zzlx LIKE '%粮%' OR zzzw LIKE '%小麦%' OR zzzw LIKE '%玉米%' OR zzzw LIKE '%粮%' THEN '粮食作物(保障口粮)' WHEN zzlx LIKE '%棉花%' OR zzzw LIKE '%棉花%' THEN '棉花(大宗经济作物)' WHEN zzlx LIKE '%苹果%' OR zzlx LIKE '%红枣%' OR zzlx LIKE '%核桃%' OR zzlx LIKE '%果%' OR zzzw LIKE '%果%' THEN '特色林果(特色经济)' WHEN zzlx LIKE '%菜%' OR zzzw LIKE '%菜%' THEN '蔬菜大棚(菜篮子工程)' ELSE '其他作物/待核实' END AS crop_category FROM jgpt_dkhc
(del_flag = '0' OR del_flag IS NULL)
AND (area_code = #{areaCode} OR qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(zzlx), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(zzzw), ''), '未申报作物'), CASE WHEN zzlx LIKE '%小麦%' OR zzlx LIKE '%玉米%' OR zzlx LIKE '%粮%' OR zzzw LIKE '%小麦%' OR zzzw LIKE '%玉米%' OR zzzw LIKE '%粮%' THEN '粮食作物(保障口粮)' WHEN zzlx LIKE '%棉花%' OR zzzw LIKE '%棉花%' THEN '棉花(大宗经济作物)' WHEN zzlx LIKE '%苹果%' OR zzlx LIKE '%红枣%' OR zzlx LIKE '%核桃%' OR zzlx LIKE '%果%' OR zzzw LIKE '%果%' THEN '特色林果(特色经济)' WHEN zzlx LIKE '%菜%' OR zzzw LIKE '%菜%' THEN '蔬菜大棚(菜篮子工程)' ELSE '其他作物/待核实' END ORDER BY total_area_mu DESC

SELECT COALESCE(area_code, qxdm) AS district_code, MAX(COALESCE(area_name, qxmc, '未知区县')) AS district_name, COUNT(1) AS contract_count, COALESCE(SUM(cbfyjzehb), 0) AS total_rent_sum, COALESCE(AVG(cbfjjhb), 0) AS avg_rent_per_mu, COALESCE(MAX(cbfjjhb), 0) AS max_rent_per_mu, COALESCE(MIN(cbfjjhb), 0) AS min_rent_per_mu FROM jgpt_htxx
(del_flag = '0' OR del_flag IS NULL)
AND (area_code = #{areaCode} OR qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
GROUP BY COALESCE(area_code, qxdm) ORDER BY total_rent_sum DESC

SELECT COALESCE(htzt, '0') AS audit_status, COUNT(1) AS status_count, COALESCE(SUM(htmj_m), 0) AS status_area_mu, CASE WHEN htzt = '1' THEN '已生效/审核通过' WHEN htzt = '2' THEN '已终止/已解除' WHEN htzt = '0' OR htzt IS NULL THEN '草拟/待审核' ELSE '其他流转状态' END AS status_desc FROM jgpt_htxx
(del_flag = '0' OR del_flag IS NULL)
AND (area_code = #{areaCode} OR qxdm LIKE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 6), '%'))
GROUP BY COALESCE(htzt, '0'), CASE WHEN htzt = '1' THEN '已生效/审核通过' WHEN htzt = '2' THEN '已终止/已解除' WHEN htzt = '0' OR htzt IS NULL THEN '草拟/待审核' ELSE '其他流转状态' END ORDER BY status_count DESC
